question: What does the speaker promise to speak, and to whom is the command to hear addressed?
premises: The speaker will speak the method of names of them.
The command to hear is addressed to you.
inference: The speaker will tell the beautiful-eyed one the method of names of those beings; she is commanded to hear.
uncertainties: The identity of 'them' is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: I shall speak the method of their names; hear, O beautiful-eyed one.
